items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: we had Mamie Smith's recording of the 'Crazy Blues' ... Mamie Smith, Bessie Smith, Ma Rainey -- they played Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Not really, not really. We got all the latest records as they came out and there was just so much. I don't think I really got interested enough in music to pay attention to who was doing what until I heard a recording by Ethel Waters, and of course we had Mamie Smith's recording of the "Crazy Blues" and we had all of the race records, Ma Rajney (phonetic spelling) and Bessie Smith, Clara Smith and we had recordings by Louie Armstrong and McKinney's Cotton Pickers, and of course one of the early race records, it…
So, anyway, you listened a lot of times like to the classic women blues singers.
